+---

+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9280'
+title: 'SessionThreadSource: live LanguageModelSession observation, streaming tail, usage, errors, cancel, profile hooks (plan §3.3)'
+---
+## What
+Create `Sources/AgentViewKitFoundationModels/SessionThreadSource.swift` and `SessionThreadActions.swift`, per plan.md §3.3.
+
+- `SessionThreadSource` (`@MainActor`): takes a `LanguageModelSession` and an `AgentThread`. Seeds from `TranscriptMapping.items(for: session.transcript)`. Tracks `session.transcript` and `session.isResponding` with `withObservationTracking` in a loop and diffs the entry ids to emit inserts, replaces, and removes. Sets `thread.state` from `isResponding`.
+- Streaming: the host calls `source.stream(_ prompt:)`, which runs `session.streamResponse(to:)`, feeds each `Snapshot.rawContent` text delta to `thread.streaming[id]`, and on completion closes the streaming message and applies the final entries from `Response.transcriptEntries`.
+- `Snapshot.usage` and `session.usage` fill `ContextUsage`. `LanguageModelError` cases become `.error` items with the case and its payload (`contextSizeExceeded` carries `contextSize` and `tokenCount`).
+- Timestamps: when the host passes a `DynamicProfile` builder, the source adds `.onPrompt`, `.onResponse`, `.onReasoning`, `.onToolCall`, and `.onToolOutput` hooks that stamp `startedAt` and `endedAt` on the matching records. Without a profile, it stamps the time it observes each entry.
+- `SessionThreadActions`: `send` starts the stream in a `Task` the source keeps; `cancel` cancels that `Task` and applies the host's `transcriptErrorHandlingPolicy`. Permission, elicitation, config, and auth verbs are no-ops that log, because the bare SDK has none.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] After `respond` completes on a session with a fake `LanguageModel`, the thread has the new user and assistant items with the transcript ids.
+- [ ] During a stream, `thread.streaming[id]` grows and the record content is set on close.
+- [ ] A thrown `LanguageModelError.contextSizeExceeded` becomes an `.error` item with both counts.
+- [ ] `cancel` cancels the running task and `thread.state` returns to `idle`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitFoundationModelsTests/SessionThreadSourceTests.swift`: a fake `LanguageModel` built on the macOS 27 `LanguageModelExecutor` protocol that scripts text, reasoning, and a tool call; assert the thread after each step.
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitFoundationModelsTests/SessionThreadSourceObservationTests.swift`: a chunk invalidates only the streaming observer, not the items observer.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitFoundationModelsTests` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
